mutants.name: REQUESTED-only presentation
mutants.semantic_invariant: OUTPUT_PRESENTATION requires affirmative RESULT_PRESENTED

mutants.name: hollow PRESENTED event
mutants.semantic_invariant: RESULT_PRESENTED requires affirmative non-null HWND and title

mutants.name: unrelated Explorer window
mutants.semantic_invariant: Target path must exist on disk and match Explorer window title

mutants.name: file exists but never displayed
mutants.semantic_invariant: Presentation is decoupled from file existence; requires affirmative display

mutants.name: black screenshot with no Astra
mutants.semantic_invariant: Surface contrast oracle requires std_dev >= 5.0 and range >= 15.0

mutants.name: genuine Astra launcher under lighter pixels
mutants.semantic_invariant: Multi-factor contrast variance detects non-flat UI structure

mutants.name: stale/wrong HWND
mutants.semantic_invariant: Win32 IsWindow & Monitor bounds check rejects invalid HWND

mutants.name: cleanup attempted but directory remains
mutants.semantic_invariant: Resource ledger requires physical absence; marks FAILED_CLEANUP on failure

mutants.name: ledger says CLOSED while physical resource remains
mutants.semantic_invariant: Post-cleanup physical absence assertion refuses CLOSED

mutants.name: prior-run telemetry contamination
mutants.semantic_invariant: Run-scoped run_id indexing isolates execution provenance

mutants.name: missing broker events on broker task
mutants.semantic_invariant: CAUSAL_PROVENANCE requires model -> broker -> action causal chain

mutants.name: semantically wrong repair artifact
mutants.semantic_invariant: AuthoritativeCompletionGate rejects VIOLATED acceptance predicates

mutants.name: exact-prompt routing patch
mutants.semantic_invariant: Structural computational and data pipeline regex in GoalPlanner

mutants.name: unverified exit_code blocks completion
mutants.semantic_invariant: AuthoritativeCompletionGate rejects PENDING predicate

mutants.name: hardcoded zero residue
mutants.semantic_invariant: Resource ledger directly inspects active resources; rejects clean=True when residue exists

mutants.name: screenshot before async postcondition
mutants.semantic_invariant: Evaluator requires matching window frame in observed frames

mutants.name: unrelated pre-existing viewer
mutants.semantic_invariant: Evaluator matches affirmative window title to target file stem
mutants.kill_reason: valid_presentation_events > 0 and matching_observed_windows > 0 and deliverables_on_disk == True

mutants.name: RESULT_PRESENTED before observation
mutants.semantic_invariant: present_result requires affirmative physical observation before emission

mutants.name: vacuous resource disposal rejected
mutants.semantic_invariant: AstraResourceLedger transitions unmaterialized/empty paths to NOT_MATERIALIZED

mutants.name: missing postcondition before GOAL_COMPLETED
mutants.semantic_invariant: AuthoritativeCompletionGate blocks completion when any predicate is UNKNOWN
